name: lanyard-react-bits
title: Lanyard
description: A realistic ID badge hanging from a woven strap on a black stage. It sways under gravity, can be grabbed and thrown with the pointer, and flips over when clicked.
use: A profile, event pass or product needs a tactile 3D object that invites dragging and flipping.
avoid: It is a heavy WebGL scene that needs a tall parent, and weak devices make the physics stutter.
a11y: The canvas has no label or keyboard controls; reduced motion only stops the ambient breeze, dragging and flipping stay pointer-only. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A glossy portrait-format badge with rounded corners and a punched slot, hung by a silver clip from a dark woven ribbon that rises out of the frame. The badge holds a full-bleed photo, with a faint grain and soft studio reflections across its surface.
behaves: The strap and badge swing on a spring like a real lanyard, never quite still in the ambient breeze. Dragging the card moves it in 3D, releasing throws it, and a short click flips it to a back face.
customise: Front and back image, fit, card colour, orientation, finish, corners, size, anchor, strap length/image/colour/width, metal, gravity, damping, elasticity, breeze and interactivity are props.
weight: heavy: A three.js scene with a physics loop and shaders renders every frame, kept moving by a breeze.
